provenance: Packaged source hashes match the worktree. All four VM image hashes and manager/controller binary hashes equal the previously verified base ISO.
limits: Diagnostic administration image, not a functional privacy beta.
Physical Wi-Fi, Ethernet adapters, KVM, Secure Boot and real provider conversations remain untested.
USB provisioning and persistent archive creation remain unavailable.
Diagnostic SSH is locally opt-in and grants the operator sudo access; it is excluded from the normal beta-iso target.
Network capture includes two ICMPv6 neighbor/multicast control frames from EDK2 before Linux networking; the guest kernel disables IPv6.
Synthetic unrelated disks remain unchanged; this is not an exhaustive physical filesystem leak audit.
resolved_failures: Install iproute2 explicitly: NetworkManager does not supply the ip command used by the console.
Adjust OCR for the nmtui gray panel and avoid reading key fingerprints as exact OCR text.
Verify the production manager numeric service UID 1000.
Give the diagnostic host a local hostname mapping so sudo does not attempt name resolution.
Disable IPv6 from the kernel command line because NetworkManager auto-created connections enabled it despite initial sysctl defaults.
